outcomes.item: The docs-site authoring collection, API routes, browser content-app labels, and service helpers now use `project data` language instead of `platform data`.

Compatibility-sensitive storage details stayed stable for tonight: the Payload slug and draft-revision enum value remain on the legacy `platform` identifiers while the service/UI surface translates them to `project data`.
Project exports now write `project-data/` directories and `projectDataCount` manifests so the authored filesystem output matches the new editor vocabulary.

follow-ups.item: Remaining phase 63 work stays parked until later productization passes: auth hardening, validation/review gates, schema-driven forms, and richer asset workflows.
